claims.evidence: One source per cell line x MaxQuant experiment (= biological replicate) x workflow arm. Arms from run names and summary.txt variable-modification groups: lysate = *_1D and *_pH3..pH11 (rows 1-56, base search); nonenriched-fractions = 1502xx_Rho0_143B_<FT_1_2|3..13>_<a-d> (rows 57-152, base search); TiO2 = *_TiO2_* (rows 153-240, + Phospho (STY)); GlyGly = *_Ubi (rows 241-248, + GlyGly (K)). Cell-line part follows the channel map (comment[label] claim).

claims.value: SILAC heavy / SILAC light per channel map: BR1, BR2 rho0 heavy + 143B light; BR3, BR4 rho0 light + 143B heavy
claims.evidence: Explicit: MaxQuant Experiment names Rho0_H1_143B_L1, Rho0_H2_143B_L2 (rho0 heavy) and Rho0_L1_143B_H1, Rho0_L2_143B_H2 (rho0 light) in experimentalDesignTemplate.txt (PXD002270 and combined.zip, identical assignments) and summary.txt; run names agree (Rho_SI_143B_LSI = rho heavy "S", 143B light "LS"; Rho_LSI_143B_SI swapped; 141211_143_SI_Rho_LSI_C_Ubi = 143B heavy in exp. L1). PRIDE: quadruplicates incl. label switch. summary.txt: Multiplicity 2, Labels1 Arg10;Lys8 on all 124 runs. Data check: protein-level log2 H/L of mtDNA-encoded MT-CO2 = -4.58/-4.28 in H1/H2 and +4.46/+6.12 in L1/L2 (rho0 lacks mtDNA); TFAM -3.14/-2.96 vs +3.18/+2.84; NDUFS1 -2.12/-2.19 vs +2.05/+2.07; Pearson H1 vs H2 +0.885, L1 vs L2 +0.873, H vs L -0.53..-0.59. Per file: 123/124 runs correlate with the rho0-heavy reference in the sign their experiment predicts (incl. every TiO2 and GlyGly run); the exception 150212_Rho0_143B_5_c (r=+0.30 on 346 pairs; only 4 strongly regulated peptides, 2/4 agree) is a low-yield fraction and uninformative, so the explicit design is kept (see limitations).

PRIDE: "Proteomic experiments were done in biological quadruplicates, including a label-switch", "one 300 cm2 polystyrene flask per replicate". The four MaxQuant experiments (H1, H2, L1, L2) are numbered 1-4; within each factor value (143B / 143B rho-0 EtBr) each experiment is an independent culture, so numbers 1-4 are unique per culture within the group.

limitations: Paper full text (Methods, supplementary) not retrievable: not OA in PMC (Europe PMC 500 / "not open access"), publisher PDF 403, PMC HTML/PDF behind reCAPTCHA (not bypassed). Fractionation chemistry (pH-step fractions pH3-pH11; FT_1_2/3-13 series before/after TiO2), reduction/alkylation reagents, and the ubiquitin-remnant enrichment method are therefore undocumented; comment[fractionation method], reduction/alkylation columns are omitted.

The 1502xx_Rho0_143B_<FT_1_2|3..13> runs are encoded as a separate non-enriched fraction series (searched without Phospho). Whether they are the TiO2 flow-through or pre-enrichment aliquots of the same peptide fractions is not documented.
The 1D run of each lysate set is treated as an unfractionated injection (technical replicate 2). MaxQuant placed it at Fraction 1 next to the pH series, and no text confirms what "1D" means.

Biological replicate numbers follow the four MaxQuant experiments. The arms were measured months apart (lysate Nov 2014, Ubi Dec 2014, phospho Feb 2015), and nothing documents whether the arms of one replicate come from the same culture/mixture or from separate ones.

Per-file orientation: 150212_Rho0_143B_5_c (nonenriched fraction 5, experiment Rho0_L1_143B_H1) gives r=+0.30 against the rho0-heavy reference (346 ratio pairs; only 4 strongly regulated peptides, 2/4 sign agreement). That is uninformative rather than contradictory; the explicit design-template assignment (rho0 light) is kept.

PXD002270 (earlier partial deposit of the same 124 raw files) is not annotated; see annotations/DUPLICATES.md Group 9. Its experimentalDesignTemplate.txt/parameters.txt are cited as evidence; its parameters.txt says Re-quantify False whereas combined/txt/parameters.txt in PXD002425 says True.
Out of scope: 174 metabolomics MRM files (.wiff/.qsession, SCIEX MultiQuant) and the 3 zip archives (MaxQuant output / software), which are not proteomics data runs.
PRIDE organismParts "bone marrow" and instrument "Q Exactive" are superseded by Cellosaurus (femur) and the raw headers (Q Exactive Plus).
Review: REVIEW_PENDING_EXTERNAL. Validated by the producer only; no adversarial review run in this task (external hand-off per batch prompt).
